# The standard root paths of the configuration files of atom tools, which
# forbid-tool-configs forbids (ADR-0005): one path per line, below the root,
# grouped by the atom that owns the tool. Every released atom adds its own.

# atom-workflows: actionlint
.github/actionlint.yaml
.github/actionlint.yml
# atom-workflows: zizmor
.github/zizmor.yml
.github/zizmor.yaml
zizmor.yml
zizmor.yaml
